clause_text: The project shall maintain a 100 metre buffer from the perennial river and no permanent structures shall be within this distance.
No activity shall be carried out within 50 m of the stream during construction and operations.
Adequate measures shall be taken to prevent discharge into nearby waterbodies.
No development within 200 metres of the notified wetland; tree felling within the buffer is prohibited.
The project proponent shall ensure a 30 m greenbelt around the river to prevent erosion.
Appropriate mitigation measures shall be implemented to avoid alteration of natural drainage patterns.
